Please find attached my suggestions for possible floorplans and layout. The bathroom is not in the scope of work 
as we havent discussed yet, however I included a small section of it to represent the part that is visible from the 
bedroom upon entry or occupancy.

beautiful in the part visible from the bedroom. Upon entry into a room I don't like to see the side of a desk or side 
of a wardrobe etc. It should be inviting and feel like an entrance. Also mindful of light and windows. I know the 
room gets beautiful morning light from the courtyard side of the room which is why it would be my preference 
to enter on this side and keep the windows open, for chairs to read and the desk.

in the photos, so I will need her to send me their exact dimensions and let me know if they are single or double 
and the way they swing. Door swings will be important for planning.

Our Guarantee 
Our goal is to provide a positive customer experience by supporting you throughout the entire 
shopping experience. We stand behind the quality of our products and the prices we charge. If you're 
not satisfied with your purchase or any part of your experience, just let us know. 
Returns & Exchanges 
We want you to be happy with your purchase and understand it can take a few days to a few weeks to 
know if your new items will work for you. We encourage you to return or exchange items in a timely 
manner because damage or wear will result in an adjustment to your refund. If an item is 
unsatisfactory we will work with you to resolve the issue to your satisfaction with expert product 
repair, parts replacement or an exchange. Please know that if you purchase items in a store without 
using your Room & Board account, a receipt will be required for returns. 
We don't charge a delivery fee for returns or exchanges within the 48 contiguous states. However, 
original delivery charges are not refundable. Credit card or gift card orders will receive a credit; orders 
paid by check or cash will receive a refund check. 
Custom Product Policy 
A non-refundable fee of 3 0 % applies to custom products that are changed, canceled or returned. Full 
refunds on custom products are only given if the custom product order is canceled within 48 hours of 
being placed or in the rare case of defects in materials or workmanship.

We decided to do a home birth. I was sick of hospitals with crappy protocols and doctors who didn't know why 
the protocols were there. We found two great midwives so decided to do a home birth. Most of the problems can 
be determined in early labor by watching vitals and the ultrasound. 
Anyway, we ended up on a weird edge case where the baby went front to back (OP) and ended up creating a very 
strong but hard to diagnose pain for Mizuka that made it unable for her to "push through" the pain in labor. We 
tried all kinds of tricks and stuff until Mizuka's pain became unbearable and was losing her energy about 12 
hours into her labor and ended up in a hospital. The reason that we went to the hospital is because Mizuka was 
being overwhelmed with the pain. When we got to the hospital it took hours for them to figure out the anesthesia 
so it was about 16 hours before she was stabilized and gave birth. Luckily she had enough energy left to push 
enough to do a forceps vaginal delivery instead of c-section. So we're in the hospital now. 
So it was a weird edge case, but Mizuka's already forgotten the pain (I remember it!) and she's thinking about it 
the next kid. ;-) 
Otherwise, baby is healthy. We're calling her Kio. We thought about Jeffrina, but thought it sounded to Western. 
- Joi 
PS I think they all sort of look about the same at this age but...

Affresh Washer Cleaner + $9.00 
Description 
5.3 cu. ft. High-Efficiency Top-Load Washer with ColorLast Option 
Give your clothes the clean they deserve with this powerful yet gentle washer from Whirlpool. Low-profile 
impeller cleans clothes thoroughly, utilizing a seamless surface and unique fin design drive clothes into the 
center of the wash basket where the deepest cleaning happens. Precision Dispense automatically release 
detergent at the optimal time during the cycle to further improve cleaning results. With ColorLast option, you 
don't have to worry about color fade - it uses a precise combination of wash action, temperature and time to keep 
vibrant clothes looking fresh. 
About Whirlpool 
At Whirlpool, advanced performance means getting great results while using less water and energy. Their 
ENERGY STAR qualified appliances deliver eco-efficient operation that exceeds the toughest government 
standards. Whirlpool is dedicated to making guesswork a thing of the past. Every detail is attended to. Every 
machine is designed to help you manage your home precisely the way you want-easier, faster and smarter. 
Available at AJ Madison. 
Energy Info 
This clothes washer uses 196 kWh/yr. and has an estimated yearly operating cost of $21.73. 
Your operating costs will depend on your utility rates and use. The estimated operating cost is based on 8 wash 
loads a week and a 2011 national average electricity cost of $0.1109 cents per kWh. 
For more information, visit www.fic.gov/appliances.

Features 
Adaptive Wash Technology with Active Bloom Wash Action 
• Senses the needs of each load and adapts water levels and wash actions accordingly for improved cleaning 
and gentler care 
ColorLast Option 
• ColorLast option uses a precise combinations of wash action, temperature and time so that clothes look 
fresh, not faded 
Clean Washer Cycle 
• Keep the washer delivering its best performance with the Clean Washer cycle that deep-fills the washer to 
clean even those areas that aren't normally reached by low-water wash cycles. Add an Affresh Washer 
cleaner tablet for best results 
Quick Wash 
• Clean small, lightly soiled loads in less time. Plus, increased spin speeds extract more water for faster thy 
times 
Deep Water Wash 
• Take on dirt with the Deep Water Wash cycle that helps break down loose soils using more water and 
thorough cleaning so stains don't stick around 
EFTA00571193
--- PAGE 17 ---
Precision Dispense 
• Improves cleaning results by releasing detergent at the correct time during the cycle for optimal fabric 
care. Detergent mixes with water to penetrate fabrics and virtually eliminate pretreating 
Low-Profile Impeller 
• Low-profile impeller helps give clothes a thorough yet gentle clean. Features a seamless surface and 
unique fins to drive clothes from the outer rim to the center of the wash basket, where the deepest cleaning 
happens 
Intuitive Touch Controls with Memory 
• Industry's first front controls on the lid help you create customized cycles while taking the guesswork out 
of the process. Simply select Power, then What you want to wash and How you want to wash it. These 
controls even remember your last settings 
Estimated Time Remaining LED Display 
• Always have an eye on how much time is left during any cycle with an enhanced estimated time remaining 
LED display 
Smooth Wave Stainless Steel Wash Basket 
• The Smooth Wave stainless steel wash basket gently guides clothes and helps protect fabrics from fraying 
and snags 
ENERGY STAR 
• ENERGY STAR qualified models exceed government standards to help conserve natural resources and 
save money on utility bills

service agent mention to me that I would need to be on my tip-toes to get clothes out of the bottom of this 
washer. (Please note - I am 5'9" tall.) Shorter family members will definitely need a step stool to use it. I really 
wish Whirlpool will step up and do the right thing by me and resolve this matter quickly and to my satisfaction.

Great Washer But 
- 
by Rwmol on 1211/15 
Overall Rating: 4 
Recommends: Yes 
Location: Washington, Utah 
"First, to the people that can't reach the bottom to remove the load. Hello. Anybody home? Didn't you look inside 
before purchasing. Buyer remorse. Not the fault of the manufacturer. Now my review. This washer is great in all 
categories, quiet, large capacity, great selections of cycles and wash options. But, I have 2 issues with this 
washer. 1. It has a 1 year warrenty. Period. Nothing extended on the motor or any other component. 2. I've 
owned this washer for 1 1/2 years. It started developing a clunking noise during agitation. Come to find out the 
splines on the rotor are made of plastic. This is obviously a design flaw. It will never hold up with the torque of 
back and forth action. The replacement part is $165. Almost as much as my extended warranty. So, word to the 
wise. Protect yourself on anything that has moving parts."
